name: Stave of the Ancients
label: Quest
description: Stave of the Ancients: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Agents of the Burning Legion are still active in our world, adventurer. These agents corrupt all that they touch. Nature wilts and weeps in their presence.

You must track down these demonic corrupters and destroy them, friend. Be warned, you must engage them by yourself or they will flee. As long as you are alone, they will try and destroy you. You must strike at them, turning their arrogance into misery.
I grant you a piece of my bark, the inscriptions shall lead you to your targets. Retrieve their heads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not be fooled by their disguises!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served us well, friend! Take this stave and combine it with the bow string that Stoma is able to create. Together, they form a most formidable weapon.
